translations.invitados.anice.bio: Born in 1999 in Amiens, France. Discovered origami in 2010 and very soon became passionate about creating original designs. At first the inspiration came from the animal world: those early models stood out for being tender and expressive. Over time, the work evolved towards hybrid figures, shaped by studies in art and design. Specializes in folding complex subjects from a single sheet and explores the “half illusion” of movement, texture and the lightness of the material. The work is internationally recognized and has led to exhibiting and teaching all over the world.
